title: Build status notification
native_variations: A build result with a heading and structured details. Some variants also include a build link. Example build numbers, fields and URLs vary; the message journey is the same.

title: Approval request with action buttons
native_variations: The same release-42 approval message in every language: Approve, Reject and Details, with matching actions and fallback text.

title: Rich-formatted alert
native_variations: Formatted alert text with a bold span. Elixir, PHP and Haskell also demonstrate an AlertBlock inside a modal; other variants use a rich-text message. AlertBlock itself is modal-only.

title: Confirmation modal
native_variations: A modal with a labelled input and submit action. Titles, input IDs and copy vary; applications still need a fresh trigger ID and a submission handler.

title: Threaded reply
native_variations: A complete message targeting an existing thread timestamp. Sample progress/completion text and timestamps vary.

title: Ephemeral slash-command response
native_variations: An interaction response with ephemeral visibility. Sample response text varies; this is a response payload, not chat.postEphemeral.

title: Multi-column status report
native_variations: The same service-status message in every language: Service/Status, API/Healthy and Worker/Degraded.

title: Colored-bar attachment
native_variations: A message containing a colored attachment. Python shows a warning and other variants show success; colors and copy intentionally differ.

title: Preview in Block Kit Builder
native_variations: A Block Kit Builder URL containing encoded native blocks. The optional workspace path and example content vary; this does not send to Slack.

title: Parse incoming modeled JSON
native_variations: Checked parsing of a section followed by native access or editing. Haskell demonstrates a checked immutable edit. Python intentionally uses a supported partial-parser type; this is not a promise of universal Python round trips.

title: Workflow button
native_variations: A workflow button with an action ID, trigger URL and customizable input parameter. Python additionally demonstrates a surrounding message; other variants print the element. Replace the example trigger and parameter with those from your workflow.

title: Typed validation error handling
native_variations: Catch the native length error and emit the shared handled/category result. The exception or result type follows each language’s API.

title: Accordion and pagination
native_variations: A collapsible section plus paginated blocks and a next-page action carrying page 2. Generated action-ID prefixes and omitted defaults vary by native helper; state remains application-owned.

title: Metadata and safe edits
native_variations: Preserve opaque false/zero metadata through a safe native edit. Java omits null because its native metadata map rejects null values; other variants retain null. Updated/Complete are alternate sample text.

title: Weighted layout grid
native_variations: The same two-row weighted service grid, visible label and plain fallback in every language.

title: Card actions
native_variations: The same two- and three-button cards in every language. Wire order is deliberate and may differ from Slack’s displayed order.
